This is based on the definition in [Document 1], where an FIR is counted as having an arrest only if any of its accused entries explicitly state گرفتار (arrested) without negation or attribution to an earlier case. The remaining 62 FIRs either have no arrest recorded (e.g., "زیر تفتیش" or "مفرور") or explicitly state no arrest (e.g., "نامزد، گرفتاری کی نوبت نہ آئی").
